# list_dynamic_functions_tool

> List available Dynamic Functions for the tenant with their status, schedule, and recent execution info.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `dynamic_functions` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List available Dynamic Functions for the tenant with their status, schedule, and recent execution info.

This tool helps discover what functions are available and their current state including:
- Function name, description, and active status
- Schedule (cron expression) and next scheduled run time
- Last execution time and result status
- OAuth connection status if configured

EXAMPLES:
List all functions: {}
List active functions: {active_only: true}
List scheduled functions: {scheduled_only: true}
List callback functions: {callbacks_only: true}
List Party callbacks: {callback_model: "Party"}
Find by name: {name: "sync"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active_only` | boolean | no | Only show active functions. |
| `scheduled_only` | boolean | no | Only show scheduled functions. |
| `callbacks_only` | boolean | no | Only show callback functions. |
| `callback_model` | string | no | Filter by callback model name (e.g., "Party", "TimeEntry") |
| `name` | string | no | Filter by function name (partial match) |
